sum: Securitize Corp. provides a platform for tokenizing and managing digital asset securities. It provides various solutions such as tokenization, fund administration, and digital asset reporting. The company has a strategic partnership with Socios.com to develop regulated tokenized equity offerings involving minority interests in professional sports teams. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Miami, Florida.
ceo: Mr. Carlos  Domingo Soriano Ph.D. (Co-Founder, CEO & Director)
